summary: Encore Capital Group issued $750M of 6.625% senior secured notes due 2032, with interest payable semiannually and secured by substantially all assets of the company and guarantors. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change is present. The filing solely concerns entry into a material definitive agreement for a debt issuance, which does not trigger any special-situations category under conservative classification standards.
